g.aria-label: Jamia-tul-Madinah California, Faizan-e-Madinah, 4110 North Freeway Blvd, Sacramento, CA 95834

g.data-info: The newest Jamia-tul-Madinah (Islamic university) campus in the USA, opened for the 2025–26 academic year. It offers the traditional 6-year Dars-e-Nizami (Aalim) course, free of charge.
